title: lycium vulgare var. barbarum
intro: Lycium vulgare var. barbarum, commonly known as Goji, is a deciduous shrub native to the Himalayan Mountains and the Tibetan Plateau. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving vision, and boosting the immune system, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Lycium vulgare var. barbarum include carotenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. These constituents have been shown to have anti-aging, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular-protective effects, making Goji a valuable resource in modern herbal medicine.
